conventions: Comments only: every source edit adds TSDoc comment lines and nothing else; no code, type, import, export, blank-line or copyright-header change.
TSDoc blocks are multi-line: a `/**` line, ` * text` lines, a ` */` line, indented to the declaration they document (2 spaces inside an interface or class, none at top level).
Wrap comment text so no line exceeds 80 columns; Prettier (`@backstage/cli/config/prettier`) does not rewrap comments, so wrap by hand.
Sentence case, full stops, plain present tense, as in packages/catalog-model/src/entity/Entity.ts and src/validation/CommonValidatorFunctions.ts.
Write `@param name - description` with the ` - ` separator; a blank ` *` line separates the summary, `@remarks` and the tag lines.
Never add, remove or move a release tag (`@public`, `@alpha`); member comments carry no release tag.
Put every `<...>`, `{`, `}`, `@`, character class and code symbol inside backticks so TSDoc does not read it as HTML, an inline tag or a block tag.
No `{@link}` tags in new comments; name other members in backticks instead.
Use the exact comment text given in each unit's rules and sites; only the line wrapping is the typist's.

decisions.choice: The 45 `(undocumented)` markers in packages/catalog-model/report.api.md, across the 15 source files of FR-1 to FR-4.

Clearing the alpha-only markers in report-alpha.api.md

decisions.choice: One block above each of `apiVersion`, `kind` and `spec`, inserted directly above the member line with no blank lines added; existing nested `spec` fields stay uncommented.
rejected: Blank lines between members as in Entity.ts
Comments on each nested spec field
decisions.reason: AC-4 requires the diff to add only comment lines, and FR-1 limits the change to the three flagged members.

decisions.choice: Fill the existing `/** @public */` block of each guard: summary paragraph, blank ` *` line, `@param entity - The entity to check`, blank ` *` line, then the existing ` * @public` line kept as is. No `@remarks` in any new comment of this run.
rejected: A new block above the existing one
`@remarks` sections (no neighbouring member or guard uses one)
decisions.reason: One TSDoc block per declaration; the `@param` mirrors src/entity/ref.ts and the boolean result is implied by the summary.

decisions.choice: A new block above each static method or `enforce` method, ending with `@param value - The value to check` (validators) or `@param entity - The entity to enforce the policy on` (policies).
decisions.reason: Matches CommonValidatorFunctions member style; return and failure behaviour is stated in the prose as FR-3 and FR-4 ask.
